title: Organic two-dimensional van der Waals heterostructures
title_zh: 有机二维范德瓦尔斯异质结构
abstract: Abstract Van der Waals heterostructures based on graphene and inorganic two-dimensional (2D) crystals enable exquisite control of interlayer coupling, and emergent electronic and optical phenomena 1,2 . Extending this concept to organic 2D crystals has been hindered by weak, non-directional interlayer interactions that frustrate lattice registry. Here we introduce a bottom-up strategy for programmable lattice engineering in organic van der Waals heterostructures of 2D polymers. Sequential on-water-surface assembly enables layer-by-layer stacking of chemically distinct 2D polymers with defined lattice registry, stacking sequence and thickness, yielding both lattice-matched and controlled lattice-mismatched heterostructures. Structural characterization reveals commensurate epitaxy in lattice-matched and small-mismatched systems, whereas large-mismatch interfaces exhibit moiré features and strain-relief distortions. Ultrafast spectroscopy demonstrates efficient interfacial charge separation and first-principles calculations reveal built-in electric fields and interfacial potential steps arising from interfacial dipole alignment. Devices exhibit diode-like rectification ratios exceeding 10 7 that systematically decrease with increasing lattice mismatch, establishing organic 2D polymer van der Waals heterostructures as a lattice-engineered platform for (opto)electronic and quantum phenomena.
abstract_zh: 摘要：基于石墨烯和无机二维（2D）晶体的范德瓦尔斯异质结构能够精确控制层间耦合，并产生新颖的电子和光学现象。将这一概念推广到有机二维晶体受到弱、无定向层间相互作用的限制，导致晶格配准困难。本文提出一种自下而上的可编程晶格工程策略，用于制备二维聚合物的有机范德瓦尔斯异质结构。通过顺序水面组装实现化学上不同二维聚合物的逐层堆叠，形成具有确定晶格配准、堆叠序列和厚度的结构，既可得到晶格匹配的异质结构，也可得到受控的晶格不匹配异质结构。结构表征显示，晶格匹配和小不匹配系统呈现共轭外延，而大不匹配界面则出现摩尔纹和应变缓解畸变。超快光谱实验表明界面电荷分离效率高，第一性原理计算揭示了由界面偶极排列产生的内置电场和界面电位阶梯。器件表现出超过10⁷的二极管式整流比，且随着晶格不匹配的增加而系统性下降，证明二维聚合物范德瓦尔斯异质结构是一个可通过晶格工程实现的（光）电子和量子现象平台。
